Name: Quick Gift Hint
Author: juhyu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[code]Quick Gift Hint shows gift suggestions from your current inventory when you hover over an NPC.

The mod only shows Loved and Liked gift candidates you are carrying. By default, it only shows gift tastes you have already discovered in the current save, so it avoids revealing unknown gift preferences unless you choose to disable that option.

Use the mouse wheel while the tooltip is visible to cycle through multiple gift candidates.[/code]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[code]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

The final folder should look like:
Stardew Valley/Mods/QuickGiftHint[/code]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[code]- Hover over NPCs to see gift candidates from your current inventory.
- Shows Loved gifts before Liked gifts.
- Compact tooltip with item icon, gift preference label, friendship hearts, and item counter.
- Mouse wheel support for cycling through multiple candidates.
- Prevents the mouse wheel from changing your held item while cycling gift hints.
- Known-only mode by default, using gift tastes discovered in the current save.
- Optional full-data mode by setting RequireKnownTastes to false.
- Configurable overlay toggle key through Generic Mod Config Menu.
- English and Korean translations.
- Works in single-player and multiplayer as a local UI-only mod.

By default, the overlay toggle key is H.

Hover over an NPC while carrying a known Loved or Liked gift for them. If multiple candidates are available, scroll the mouse wheel while the tooltip is visible to cycle through them.

Configuration
- EnableMod
- ShowLovedGifts
- ShowLikedGifts
- RequireKnownTastes
- ToggleOverlayKey
- MaxItemsShownPerCategory

Most options are available through Generic Mod Config Menu.
MaxItemsShownPerCategory is currently config.json-only.

Important note about known-only mode
By default, RequireKnownTastes is enabled.

When enabled, Quick Gift Hint only shows gift preferences your farmer has already discovered in the current save. If you are carrying a correct gift but have not discovered that NPC's reaction to it yet, the tooltip will not reveal it.

If you want the mod to use the game's full gift data regardless of discovery, set RequireKnownTastes to false in config.json.[/code]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[code]Required:
- SMAPI 4.2.1 or newer
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer

Optional:
- Generic Mod Config Menu, for changing most settings in-game[/code]
